body: at dusk: the crop trial crew brought sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I washed everything twice before the siren began.
title: At dusk: sealed seed packet
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

body:
They told us the list was for families. I believed them until the families arrived and nobody would let them see it.

One woman recognized a coat through the window. The man at the door said the coat belonged to a different person and closed the curtain. She waited for hours because no one would tell her whose coat she had seen.

I wrote down the time they took the list. If she comes back I can at least tell her when we stopped being allowed to answer.
title: The visitor list
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
